## Prices for 2027

Price in USD per person for the 8-day / 7-night programme.

| Occupancy | Price per person |
| --- | ---: |
| SGL — single | $2372 |
| DBL — double | $1908 |
| TPL — triple | $1855 |

The domestic flight from Mexico City to Mérida and accommodation on the Caribbean coast are not included in these rates.

## From the capital to the Yucatán

The first four nights are spent in Mexico City: the historic centre, ancient pyramids and the canals of Xochimilco offer three different perspectives on the capital and its surroundings. After the flight, the route changes: three nights in Mérida give you time to explore the colonial city, Maya architecture and freshwater cenotes.

On the final day, the journey via Chichén Itzá and Valladolid ends with drop-off on the Caribbean coast. You can choose Cancún, Playa del Carmen or Tulum town and book an extension separately.
